items.note: Al-Shaair (knee) does not have any injury designation for Sunday's game against the Giants, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.

items.name: Woody Marks
items.note: Marks is lined up to start at running back against the Giants on Sunday with David Montgomery (groin) ruled out.

items.name: Dalton Schultz
items.note: Schultz (quadriceps) was a full participant in Friday's practice and doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Giants, Adam Caplan or SiriusXM reports.

items.name: David Montgomery
items.note: Montgomery (groin) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Giants, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.

items.name: Blake Fisher
items.note: out

items.name: Calen Bullock
items.note: Bullock tallied five tackles (three solo) and an interception during Houston's win over the Jaguars on Sunday.

items.name: Jake Hummel
items.note: Hummel isn't expected to resume practicing this week while he continues to recover from groin surgery, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

items.name: Xavier Hutchinson
items.note: Hutchinson caught two of three passes for 10 yards and returned two kickoffs for 52 yards during the Texans' 34-31 win over the Jaguars on Sunday in London.

items.name: Ka'imi Fairbairn
items.note: Fairbairn made both of his field-goal tries and converted all four of his extra-point attempts in a 34-31 win against the Jaguars in London in Week 6.

items.name: Tank Dell
items.note: Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday that Dell (knee) is on track to return from injured reserve to make his season debut in Week 7 versus the Giants, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

items.name: Kayshon Boutte
items.note: Boutte finished with two receptions for 16 yards on three targets in Sunday's 34-31 win over the Jaguars in London.

items.name: Foster Moreau
items.note: Moreau caught both of his targets for seven yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 34-31 win over the Jaguars in London.

items.name: Jaylin Noel
items.note: Noel gathered in all four targets for 107 yards and one touchdown during Sunday's 34-31 win against the Jaguars in London.

items.name: Kahleil Jackson
items.note: Jackson (undisclosed) is inactive for Saturday's game against Vanderbilt, G. Allan Taylor of The Athletic reports.

items.name: Braylen Walker
items.note: Walker caught four passes for 77 yards and a touchdown versus UNT on Saturday.

items.name: Will Bettridge
items.note: Bettridge made four field goals in Saturday's 14-12 victory over Miami.
